tax.text: Groves calls for reducing federal taxes to stimulate the economy.
tax.quote: In Washington, Ralph Groves will uphold Social Security and Medicare, and will call for reduction of Federal taxes to stimulate the economy.

debt.text: Groves says he would uphold Social Security and Medicare while addressing the deficit through economic growth.
debt.quote: In Washington, Ralph Groves will uphold Social Security and Medicare, and will call for reduction of Federal taxes to stimulate the economy.

schools.text: Groves supports offering parents vouchers, homeschooling, and other educational options.
schools.quote: In addition, a broad range of options should be available to parents, including a voucher system and homeschooling.

immigration.text: Groves advocates increasing legal immigration through simpler and more reasonable processes.
immigration.quote: He believes in simplified, reasonable immigration processes to enhance legal, regulated immigration.

guns.text: Groves opposes expanding gun-purchase background checks, arguing that criminals would evade them.
guns.quote: Expanded background checks will not keep guns out of the hands of criminals and gang members; in any case, such checks will be inexact as not all records about people are available to adjudicators.

abortion.text: Groves urged Florida senators to support legislation specifically because it would curtail abortion funding.
abortion.quote: Ralph Groves, 2026 Candidate of the Libertarian Party of Florida for the 11th Congressional District, urges Senators Rick Scott and Ashley Moody to vote in favor of H.R. 1 (The One Big Beautiful Bill) in particular because it curtails funding for abortions.

energy.text: Groves supports increasing fossil-fuel production to reduce transportation and product costs and expects a slow transition to green energy.
energy.quote: An increase in fossil fuel output will lower costs of transport and prices of all products based on petrochemicals. Transition to “green energy” will take decades to accomplish.

tax.text: Pericola proposes eliminating federal income taxes for people earning under $100,000 and cutting taxes for middle-class families.
tax.quote: Work to eliminate income taxes for those making less than $100,000 a year and cut taxes for middle-class families.

trade.text: He opposes broad tariffs because he says they raise consumer costs.
trade.quote: including broad tariffs that function as a tax on many of the goods people buy every day.

debt.text: He opposes cutting or privatizing Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Oppose any cuts or privatization of Social Security and Medicare, and push to let Medicare negotiate lower prescription drug costs for seniors.

housing.text: He supports expanding the supply of affordable housing as part of his cost-of-living agenda.
housing.quote: expanding the supply of affordable housing, and cracking down on price gouging and anti-competitive practices that leave consumers with fewer choices and higher prices.

schools.text: He says federal education funding should strengthen public schools rather than be diverted elsewhere.
schools.quote: Federal funding should strengthen public schools, not divert resources away from them.

immigration.text: He supports an earned path to citizenship for long-term residents and more timely immigration adjudication.
immigration.quote: We should build a system that resolves claims fairly and promptly and create a rigorous, earned path to citizenship for long-term residents

health.text: He supports restoring Medicaid funding and protecting the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: We need to restore Medicaid funding, protect the Affordable Care Act, and lower the cost of prescription drugs and medical care.

voting.text: He says required citizenship documents should be free and easy for eligible voters to obtain.
voting.quote: If such a requirement became law, I would fight to ensure that every necessary document is free and easy to obtain.

tax.text: Strada says Washington should cut waste and bureaucracy before asking taxpayers for more money.
tax.quote: Cut waste, fraud, and bloated bureaucracy before Washington asks taxpayers for another dime.

debt.text: Strada promises to preserve Social Security payments and protect earned benefits.
debt.quote: Social Security is the promise we made to you, and I promise you we will keep that promise. You will get your check.

schools.text: Strada supports allowing families to choose among public, charter, private, and home schools.
schools.quote: Empower families with the freedom to choose the school, public, charter, private, or homeschool, that fits their child best.

safety.text: Strada supports law enforcement and tougher punishment for violent offenders.
safety.quote: Back law enforcement, punish violent offenders, and make communities safe again.

immigration.text: Strada supports completing the border wall and stopping unauthorized border crossings.
immigration.quote: Finish the wall, restore order, stop illegal crossings, and put American citizens first.

guns.text: Strada pledges to defend the constitutional right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: Protect freedom of speech, religious liberty, due process, and the right to keep and bear arms.

energy.text: Strada prioritizes lower energy costs, energy independence, and protection of American workers.
energy.quote: Lower costs, restore energy independence, and stop punishing American workers and families.

voting.text: Strada supports voter identification, voter-roll maintenance, and paper-ballot accountability.
voting.quote: Support voter ID, clean voter rolls, paper ballot accountability, and election integrity.

sources: grovesforcongress.com · jamespericola.com · floridapolitics.com · onyourballot.vote411.org · orangeobserver.com · votestrada.com · wintergardenvox.com
